text:
jordan: Heads-up — planning to deploy console UI v3.4.1 to canary (us-west) tonight at 21:00 PT. 30m canary window. @priya can you run smoke checks? I'll trigger the canary deploy. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
priya: yep, I'll be online. smoke checklist: login, main dashboard load, widgets refresh, nav links, feature-flag toggle. I'll run `yarn smoke:console` and hit canary route.
leo: I'll handle CDN invalidation. Plan: wait ~10m after canary healthy, then CloudFront invalidation for `/static/console/*`. If rollback, I'll cancel and run a targeted purge.
sarah: product note — hold new onboarding banner behind ff until post-smoke ok.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy created by jordan -> canary/us-west at 21:00 PT (runbook rb-2026-0317-01).
jordan: rollback plan: 1) revert commit in deploy console 2) flip `console_ui_rollout` flag back 3) invalidate any partial caches 4) notify infra for hotfix slot. aim to keep rollback <10m.
priya: quick checklist + commands:
```
# local smoke
yarn install && yarn build:console
yarn smoke:console --env=canary
# basic healthcheck
curl -f https://canary.console.redwood.ai/health || exit 1
```
leo: I'll queue invalidation 10m after `deploy-bot` reports healthy. tagging this thread when I run it. :white_check_mark: 
priya: also will run a CSS snapshot compare — `reg-snap --baseline=prod --target=canary` (should catch visual regressions).
jordan: if Sentry errors >5% during canary, hold and rollback. I'll be on standby 20:30–22:00 PT — ping me here.
sarah: noted, thanks. good luck :rocket:
deploy-bot: canary start initiated at 21:00 PT. health checks running.
deploy-bot: canary healthy at 21:04 PT.
leo: starting invalidation in ~6m and will post ID once submitted.
leo: invalidation submitted — id: I1234567890. ETA ~3m.
priya: smoke run complete — all green, snapshots OK, no nav regressions.
jordan: canary looks good, proceeding to staggered rollout to 20% at 21:40 PT. tagging infra for scaling checks.
deploy-bot: rollout to 20% started at 21:40 PT.
leo: CDN invalidation completed successfully.
priya: running another quick load test for dashboard widgets under 20% traffic.
priya: load test looks fine,  p95 latency within SLO.
jordan: everything checks out. scheduling full rollout at 22:00 PT unless any objections.
priya: no objections from me.
sarah: thumbs up from product.
deploy-bot: full rollout started at 22:00 PT.
leo: monitoring edge metrics — will post if any 4xx/5xx spikes.
priya: small blip: a couple image 404s detected (investigating), otherwise ok.
jordan: if 404s are static assets, try forcing S3 object refresh and re-running invalidation. keep me posted.
leo: confirmed early 404s due to an asset path mismatch in one bundle. pushing fix and scheduling a quick partial redeploy to fix assets only.
priya: snapshots still look fine after partial fix.
deploy-bot: rollout complete at 22:12 PT. metrics summary: 99.8% success, 0.2% errors (image 404s addressed).
jordan: thanks team — closing monitoring window at 23:00 PT. file follow-up: add the asset-path test to preflight script.
sarah: adding to the checklist. nice job everyone :tada:
